name: Board Game Scorekeeper
description: One table, good company, every point accounted for. Offline rounds, corrections and local game history.

games.title: Select game
games.welcome: Every game deserves a good record
games.hint: 2–12 players, high or low score wins. Negative scores, shared places and saved games.

form.newHint: Players, scoring direction and round settings are fixed at creation. Names can change; seat IDs stay stable.
form.copyHint: Keep the players, direction, round target and quick steps. Preserve this game and start fresh.
form.renameHint: Duplicate names are fine. Stable seat IDs keep each player’s history intact.
form.editHint: Old scores are on the left, new scores on the right. Saving recalculates every later total and rank, with an audit record.
form.name: Game name
form.manual: Leave blank to end manually, up to 200 rounds

entry.hint: Enter integers from −1,000,000 to 1,000,000. Blank is missing; 0 is an explicit score. Save typed drafts before leaving; quick steps save immediately.

confirm.finishHint: Use the pages below to review every confirmed round. Ties share a rank. Reopen the game before correcting finished results.
confirm.reopenHint: The old settlement is cleared and the game becomes active. Review and confirm a new settlement after editing.
confirm.delete: Delete this game and its history?
confirm.deleteHint: Scores, drafts and audit history will be deleted. This cannot be undone. Export JSON first if needed.
confirm.undoHint: Restore scores, draft, names or settlement to their previous state and recalculate ranks. One undo step is kept; undo is also audited.

result.finishedHint: Final confirmed ranks are shown above, with shared places for ties. Export a keepsake or start another game with the same setup.
result.readyHint: Scores can still be corrected. Choose Review & finish to confirm the result and mark this game as finished.

table.hint: Confirmed rounds only. Each cell shows the round score and cumulative total. Drafts never count toward rankings.

audit.hint: Newest first. Before/after scores retain stable player IDs. Up to 1,000 operations; history is never silently trimmed.

save.ready: Offline on this device · confirmed rounds only
save.failed: Save failed. The last saved result remains on screen.

help: Create a 2–12-player game and choose high or low score wins. Players, direction, steps and round target are fixed; names can change. Signed integer scores only; blank differs from 0. Quick steps save immediately; save typed drafts or confirm the round before leaving. All players need scores to confirm. Only confirmed rounds count toward totals. Correct old scores in the ledger to recalculate later totals; the audit trail keeps before/after values. One-step undo includes finishing and reopening. Fixed targets still require explicit review and settlement. Reopen finished games before editing. Limits: 100 games, 200 rounds per game, ±1,000,000 per player per round, 1,000 operations per game, 2 MiB total state. Limits reject operations without silently discarding history. JSON archives one complete game with drafts and audit records. CSV contains confirmed round scores only. Import is not supported in this version. Everything stays in the existing ToolForge SQLite database, without network requests.

boardgame-score.name: Names must contain 1–80 characters without control characters.
boardgame-score.score: Enter a valid integer with absolute value at most {{limit}}.
boardgame-score.players: Use 2–12 players. Player count is fixed after creation.
boardgame-score.state: Stored state is invalid or exceeds limits. Existing data was not overwritten.
boardgame-score.storage_limit: The 2 MiB state or revision limit was reached. Export and delete unneeded games.
boardgame-score.missing: Game not found. Reload saved games.
boardgame-score.stale: The round or state has changed. Retry from the current view.
boardgame-score.incomplete: Enter a score for every player. Use 0 explicitly for a zero score.
boardgame-score.round_limit: Use 1–200 rounds without exceeding this game’s target.
boardgame-score.step: Quick steps must be distinct positive integers (1–1,000,000).
boardgame-score.games_limit: Up to 100 games can be saved. Export and delete unneeded games first.
boardgame-score.events_limit: This game reached 1,000 operations. History is preserved. Export an archive and start a fresh game with this setup.
boardgame-score.finished: This game is finished. Explicitly reopen it before editing.
boardgame-score.confirm: Review and confirm this operation first.
boardgame-score.unsettled: Confirm at least one round, then confirm or clear the draft before finishing.
boardgame-score.undo: No undo step is available. Only one step is kept.
boardgame-score.file: File could not be saved or the path is invalid.
boardgame-score.target: Complete the fixed round target before settlement.
